newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds slip, eyes on Britain, Germany.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds slip, eyes on Britain, Germany.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened down on Thursday with attention focused on London, where the newly-independent Bank of England was expected to raise rates in order to stave off economic overheating.
"If the British market reacts strongly to the Bank of England announcement it could affect us," a dealer said.
Players will also be watching Germany, where the Bundesbank council holds its summer meeting, followed by a news conference, but there are few expectations of changes to key German rates.
At 0715 GMT the touchstone seven percent Danish government bond, due in 2007, was down 0.19 point, to 106.46.
